paragraphs.text: Most people spend a surprising amount of their lives waiting in line, and the frustration it causes has attracted the attention of psychologists as well as engineers. Their studies suggest that how long we wait matters less than how the wait feels.
paragraphs.label: A

paragraphs.text: One well-known finding is that time spent doing nothing seems longer than time filled with activity. A hotel that received complaints about slow lifts is said to have solved the problem not by speeding them up but by putting mirrors beside the doors, giving guests something to look at.
paragraphs.label: B

paragraphs.text: Uncertainty also makes waiting harder. When passengers at a railway station were shown a screen giving the exact number of minutes until the next train, they rated the same delay as shorter than passengers who had no information.
paragraphs.label: C

paragraphs.text: Fairness is another factor. People become angry if someone who arrived later is served first, which is why many banks and post offices now use a single line leading to several counters rather than a separate line for each counter.
paragraphs.label: D

paragraphs.text: Some businesses have gone further and removed the physical queue altogether. Customers receive a text message when it is their turn, and are free to shop or sit in a café in the meantime. Early results show that customers who wait this way are less likely to leave before being served.
paragraphs.label: E

items.quote: solved the problem not by speeding them up but by putting mirrors beside the doors
items.prompt: an example of a problem solved without making a service faster

explanation.en: The example is the hotel with slow lifts, solved “not by speeding them up but by putting mirrors beside the doors” → B.
explanation.kk: Мысал — баяу лифті бар қонақүй: мәселені «not by speeding them up but by putting mirrors beside the doors» шешкен → B.
explanation.ru: Пример — отель с медленными лифтами: проблему решили «not by speeding them up but by putting mirrors beside the doors» → B.

items.quote: they rated the same delay as shorter than passengers who had no information
items.prompt: the effect of giving people precise information about a delay

explanation.en: Passengers shown “the exact number of minutes” rated the same delay as shorter → C. “Precise information” = “exact number of minutes”.
explanation.kk: «The exact number of minutes» көрген жолаушылар сол кідірісті қысқарақ деп бағалаған → C. «Precise information» = «exact number of minutes».
explanation.ru: Пассажиры, видевшие «the exact number of minutes», оценивали ту же задержку как более короткую → C. «Precise information» = «exact number of minutes».

items.quote: which is why many banks and post offices now use a single line leading to several counters
items.prompt: a reason why some organisations changed the way their queues are arranged

explanation.en: The reason is fairness: people get angry when someone who arrived later is served first, “which is why many banks and post offices now use a single line” → D. In E the queue is removed altogether, but for another reason.
explanation.kk: Себеп — әділдік сезімі: кейін келгенге бірінші қызмет көрсетілсе, адамдар ашуланады, «which is why many banks and post offices now use a single line» → D. E абзацында кезек мүлде алынып тасталған, бірақ себебі басқа.
explanation.ru: Причина — чувство справедливости: люди злятся, когда пришедшего позже обслуживают раньше, «which is why many banks and post offices now use a single line» → D. В абзаце E очередь убрали совсем, но причина там другая.

items.quote: customers who wait this way are less likely to leave before being served
items.prompt: evidence that a new system reduced the number of people who give up waiting

explanation.en: The evidence is the early results of the text-message system: “customers who wait this way are less likely to leave before being served”. Fewer people give up → E.
explanation.kk: Дәлел — SMS жүйесінің алғашқы нәтижелері: «customers who wait this way are less likely to leave before being served». Күтпей кететін адамдар азайған → E.
explanation.ru: Доказательство — первые результаты новой системы с SMS: «customers who wait this way are less likely to leave before being served». Меньше людей уходит, не дождавшись, → E.

items.quote: how long we wait matters less than how the wait feels
items.prompt: the claim that the experience of waiting matters more than its length

explanation.en: Already in the first paragraph: “how long we wait matters less than how the wait feels” → A. The last item matches the first paragraph — this type has no order.
explanation.kk: Бірінші абзацтың өзінде: «how long we wait matters less than how the wait feels» → A. Соңғы тармақ бірінші абзацқа қатысты — бұл түрде рет жоқ.
explanation.ru: Уже в первом абзаце: «how long we wait matters less than how the wait feels» → A. Последний пункт относится к первому абзацу — порядка в этом типе нет.

groups.instruction: Questions 1–5. The reading passage has five paragraphs, A–E. Which paragraph contains the following information? Write the correct letter, A–E.
